name: Select B Roll
description: Selects B-roll clips based on A-roll assignments and semantic analysis.

inputs.name: voiceover_assignments
inputs.description: State input: voiceover_assignments - step 3.01's voiceover-sourced speech blocks (words from a catalogued audio file, no V1 picture). The bridge reads which positions those are: a position claimed by both a video and a voiceover assignment is refused, and the handoff tells the model a voiceover block needs B-roll cover like any block with no V1 picture. Absent on runs whose assign_aroll predates it; empty on runs with no voiceover.

inputs.name: creative_brief
inputs.description: The captain's creative direction as markdown, injected by the runner from the project's creative_brief path. Empty when the project declares none.

inputs.name: project_context
inputs.description: The project's context folder plus the learnings routed to this step, as a MAP the model follows with its shell (never a copy). Injected by the runner from the project's context/ folder and learned_context/ store when this step declares it; a stated absence when the project has neither. See library/tools/project_context.py.

inputs.name: timeline_notes
inputs.description: The captain's own notes typed onto the built timeline in DaVinci Resolve, routed to this step because this step owns the decision each note is about. Injected by the runner from <project>/marker_feedback/ and absent when there are none. See library/tools/marker_routing.py.

outputs.name: b_roll_assignments
outputs.expected_schema: broll_selections.b_roll_assignments: secondary footage assigned to cover an A-roll segment (AGENTS.md section 7). Validated on the manifest by library/tools/manifest_validator.py.

outputs.name: b_roll_interjections
outputs.expected_schema: broll_selections.b_roll_interjections: standalone cutaways inserted as a visual break (AGENTS.md section 7). The window that plays is library/tools/cutaway_window.py.

outputs.name: footage_analysis_reference
outputs.description: Bridge output: the vision pass's per-clip analysis as a REFERENCE - every document written to this step's own directory as footage_analysis.md, and a map naming each clip by the catalogue id the rest of the prompt uses, with its scene, camera and object counts and the line range that holds the whole record. This step carried THREE views of one analysis - this structure, the candidate table rendered from it and the observed-action rows - at 60.7% of its context, of which the raw structure alone was 40.5% (35,813 B on 001). The mechanism is library/tools/brief_reference.py, the same one #295 built for the creative brief and #299 applied to the SFX catalogue; the shape is library/tools/footage_reference.footage_document. Declared here because the bridge emits it on every run and validate_step_output otherwise reports it as an unexpected extra field.

outputs.name: broll_window_frames
outputs.description: A map of the frame strips the pre-bridge drew, one per candidate cutaway window, with the directory holding them. Prompt-only: it shows the model what a window LOOKS like beside the prose that says what it does. See library/tools/window_frames.py.

llm_outputs.name: broll_creative
llm_outputs.description: B-roll selections. Each: clip_id (from broll_candidates_toon), spine_block_position, preferred_moment, selection_rationale. NEVER select the clip the block's A-roll already shows. Empty is a legitimate answer when every block already plays its own picture and no interjection is earned (the handoff sets no required number, captain's ruling 2026-08-20); the post-bridge still refuses a block with no V1 picture left uncovered.

llm_outputs.name: b_roll_interjections
llm_outputs.description: Standalone cutaways. Each: clip_id, over_spine_block_position, timeline_start, timeline_end, purpose
